name: Modernize Kafka
problem: Migrate from an existing Kafka distribution while retaining client compatibility and independent tooling.
flow: Existing Kafka → MirrorMaker 2 → Instaclustr Kafka → developer tools
stack: Kafka, MirrorMaker 2, AKHQ, Conduktor, Kpow, Kafbat, Lenses
demo: Replicate a topic and verify offsets, record counts and cutover readiness.

name: Real-time sports intelligence
problem: Turn continuously arriving sports news into searchable, analytical and AI-accessible intelligence.
flow: X / RSS → Kafka → processing → ClickHouse / Cassandra / OpenSearch / PostgreSQL → Sports Pulse + MCP
stack: Kafka, ClickHouse, Cassandra, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL, Cadence, MCP, Grafana
demo: Explore a sample headline and trace the planned data path. Live services are not connected.

name: Change data capture
problem: Keep downstream search and analytics in sync with transactional changes.
flow: PostgreSQL → Debezium / Kafka Connect → Kafka → ClickHouse + OpenSearch
demo: Change a synthetic order and compare downstream state and lag.

name: Order fulfillment
problem: Coordinate payments, inventory and shipping despite failures.
demo: Inspect retries and compensation in a synthetic order workflow.

name: Real-time fraud detection
problem: Detect suspicious transactions without blocking operational ingestion.
flow: Kafka → streaming rules → ClickHouse / Cassandra → Cadence
demo: Detect a synthetic anomaly and open a case workflow.

name: Edge-to-cloud industrial IoT
problem: Stream sensor telemetry, retain edge data, and trigger maintenance.
flow: Edge ONTAP → Kafka → Cassandra / ClickHouse → Spark → Cadence
stack: NetApp ONTAP, Kafka, Cassandra, ClickHouse, Spark, Cadence, Grafana
demo: Compare recent readings, aggregate trends and maintenance triggers.

name: Unified observability
problem: Correlate infrastructure metrics, logs and application events.
flow: OpenTelemetry / Fluent Bit → Kafka → OpenSearch / ClickHouse → Grafana
demo: Explore correlated logs and metrics from a synthetic incident.

name: Multi-region disaster recovery
problem: Design and validate recovery objectives without disrupting production.
flow: Primary region → service-specific replication → secondary region
stack: Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, NetApp storage where applicable
demo: Measure RPO and RTO in an isolated environment; validate service-specific failover.

name: Hybrid enterprise AI assistant
problem: Retrieve enterprise data and governed tools across hybrid environments.
flow: ONTAP documents → indexing → OpenSearch / PostgreSQL pgvector → MCP → agent
stack: ONTAP, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL, pgvector, MCP Gateway
demo: Ask a question over approved documents with source attribution and bounded tool access.

name: Real-time customer 360
problem: Combine operational and behavioral data for a current customer view.
demo: Explore a synthetic customer profile and historical engagement.

name: Open lakehouse
problem: Retain stream data in open table formats with independent compute.
flow: Kafka → supported Iceberg writer/catalog → StorageGRID → Spark / Trino
stack: Kafka, Apache Iceberg, NetApp StorageGRID, Spark, Trino
demo: Query the same approved Iceberg tables with multiple engines.

name: Databricks & Snowflake integration
problem: Connect operational streams to existing enterprise analytics investments.
flow: PostgreSQL → Kafka → ClickHouse + Databricks or Snowflake
demo: Compare low-latency operational aggregates with enterprise analytical workloads.

name: Hot-to-cold data lifecycle
problem: Serve recent data at low latency while retaining historical records efficiently.
flow: Kafka → ClickHouse hot data → Iceberg / object storage historical data
demo: Compare hot and historical queries and retention trade-offs.

name: Cloud-native storage and analytics
problem: Pair managed data services with cloud-native NetApp storage where supported.
flow: Managed PostgreSQL / ClickHouse → approved NetApp cloud storage integration
stack: FSx for NetApp ONTAP, Azure NetApp Files, Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse
demo: Evaluate documented service/storage combinations, not assumed cross-cloud parity.
